Hand your phone to a player for 30 seconds and let them choose which harmless photo to show the group.
Give a completely serious one-minute speech defending an opinion you do not actually hold.
Let the group choose a harmless nickname for you that everyone must use for the next three rounds.
Look around the room and give each player one brutally honest but kind compliment.
Tell the group one harmless secret using your most dramatic storytelling voice.
Let another player choose a word you must naturally work into every answer for the next two rounds.
Give an acceptance speech for an imaginary award the group invents for you.
Act like you are being interviewed about the most ridiculous scandal you've ever been involved in.
Choose one player and let them ask you one question you must answer immediately.
Give a 20-second motivational speech about something completely ordinary.
Let the group choose an emotion, then tell a completely normal story while acting as if you feel it intensely.
Read your last harmless notification out loud without explaining the context.
Make a dramatic apology to an everyday object in the room.
Let another player choose your speaking style for the next round, such as whispering or sounding overly formal.
Tell the group your most embarrassing harmless habit while maintaining completely serious eye contact.
Give a fake press conference defending yourself against an imaginary accusation chosen by the group.
Choose someone and let them give you a harmless challenge you can complete in 20 seconds.
Stand up and deliver your most convincing fake campaign speech for yourself as if you were running for an absurd title.
Let the group choose a random word and invent a believable story explaining why it changed your life.
Give the person across from you a completely sincere compliment in the most dramatic voice possible.
Act out how you look when you think nobody is watching.
Tell the group a harmless confession while pretending you are revealing a world-changing secret.
Let another player pick one of your recent emojis, then explain an imaginary dramatic story behind it.
Give a 30-second dramatic monologue about the last thing you ate or drank.
Choose one player and imitate their completely harmless mannerism until they guess what you are doing.
Let the group ask you three rapid-fire questions and answer each without pausing.
Make up a ridiculous headline about your life and read it like breaking news.
Give yourself a new stage name and explain the story behind it with total confidence.
Let another player choose a harmless pose you must hold while answering your next question.
Deliver a serious weather report describing the mood inside this room.
Pick a player and give them an exaggerated celebrity-style introduction.
Tell the group one thing you would never put on a dating profile, without revealing anything sexual or deeply personal.
Give a dramatic courtroom defense of the most questionable harmless choice you've made today.
Let the group choose an ordinary object and convince everyone it is secretly extremely valuable.
Perform a 20-second commercial advertising yourself as if you were a product.
Choose one player and tell them a truth about yourself that you have never mentioned to them before.
Speak only in questions for the next minute while everyone tries to make you break the rule.
Give a completely sincere thank-you speech to someone for something extremely small.
Act out your reaction to receiving the most unbelievable good news imaginable.
Let another player choose a harmless word you are forbidden to say until your next turn.

Let a player choose one harmless question and answer it instantly without preparing.
Give a dramatic confession about something completely ordinary, like choosing your favorite snack.
Let another player choose your opening line for a fake speech you must deliver for 20 seconds.
Pick someone and tell them one genuinely unexpected thing you appreciate about them.
Pretend you are famous and answer three questions from the group about your imaginary scandal.
Let the group choose a harmless emotion and use it while delivering your next answer.
Give a completely serious tutorial on how to do something you are terrible at.
Choose a player and let them invent a harmless rumor about you that you must dramatically deny.
